turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Northwind Financial, my name is Nadia. Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'd like to pay my balance with a different card.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can take the last four digits only.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Let me just read it out, it's four two four two four two four two four two four two four two four two.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I only need the last four, but I have what I need.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: And my phone is six five zero five five five zero one nine eight if the payment fails.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Payment of four hundred dollars went through.

labels.notes: Card and phone fully spelled out as digit words. No digits appear in the text at all.
